v3_temporal.timestamp_recommendation: Use nominal_start_time for all temporal joins

v6_borneo_mask.limitation: Rectangular bbox includes ocean pixels. ~30-50% may be non-Kalimantan.
v6_borneo_mask.recommendation: Use island polygon for production. Bbox OK for MVP.

global_attrs.title: Himawari-9 AHI B07 Kalimantan Subset
global_attrs.source: NOAA Himawari-9 AHI HSD via AWS S3 noaa-himawari9

v9_ml_readiness.recommended_ml_format: Parquet (flattened) for training, NetCDF for archive

v10_join_readiness.join_strategy: Nearest neighbor spatial (KD-tree or xarray sel), time window ±5-30min
issues: 1. RESOLUTION MISMATCH: Himawari 2km vs VIIRS 375m. Need to decide canonical grid.
2. TEMPORAL MISALIGNMENT: VIIRS overpass ~1-2x/day vs Himawari 10-min. Use time window.
3. MISSING VALUES: Himawari has cloud NaN. VIIRS fire only when active. Require merge strategy.
4. CRS: All sources use WGS84 lat/lon -> join by nearest lat/lon OK.
5. TIMESTAMP FORMAT: Must ensure all sources use UTC before join.
6. GRID TYPE: Himawari is irregular 2D geostationary grid -> flatten before join.

v11_leakage.recommendation: Enforce strict temporal cutoff: features from [T-N, T], label from [T, T+D]
v11_leakage.viirs_role: Primary label/target; historical fire as feature only if lagged

limitations.detail: B07 is opaque to clouds. Fire beneath cloud cover is INVISIBLE.
limitations.impact: High — Kalimantan has persistent cloud cover, especially during rainy season.
limitations.mitigation: Use multi-temporal compositing; cross-reference with cloud mask.

limitations.detail: 3.9 um is mixed thermal+reflected solar during daytime (06-18 LT).
limitations.impact: Medium — reflected solar component inflates BT in daytime; harder to distinguish fire.
limitations.mitigation: Use nighttime data or apply solar zenith correction / BTD method.

limitations.detail: Bare soil, asphalt, or other hot surfaces can produce elevated BT without fire.
limitations.impact: Medium — especially in dry season when surfaces heat strongly.
limitations.mitigation: Use Band Difference (B07-B13 or B07-B14) to distinguish fire from hot surface.

limitations.detail: 2 km resolution. Small fires (<< 1 km2) may not produce detectable signal.
limitations.impact: High — early-stage fires are often small.
limitations.mitigation: Complement with VIIRS 375m active fire for small fire detection.

limitations.detail: B07 alone cannot discriminate fire type, intensity, or FRP (Fire Radiative Power).
limitations.impact: High — need multi-band approach for fire characterization.
limitations.mitigation: Add B13 (10.4 um), B14 (11.2 um), B15 (12.4 um) for BTD algorithm.

limitations.detail: Standard fire indices (NDVI, NBR, etc.) require different band combinations.
limitations.mitigation: For fire RISK (not detection), combine BT with vegetation and dryness indices.

limitations.detail: B07 can saturate at very high temperatures (> ~500 K for intense fires).
limitations.impact: Low for risk prediction; relevant for fire intensity estimation.
limitations.mitigation: Note saturation flag in HSD metadata when processing.
